title: Impact of Local Labor Demand Shocks on Wages
research_question: How do shifts in local labor demand, driven by industry-specific productivity changes, affect wages in different regions? By using a shift-share approach, we aim to isolate the exogenous variation in labor demand to understand its causal impact on wage levels.
data_description: The dataset contains 300 observations with columns: y (wages), x (local labor demand), z (Bartik shift-share instrument), and controls (demographic and economic variables). The Bartik instrument is constructed using national industry growth rates interacted with regional industry shares.
